title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
summary: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
summary: Lilly Creightmore, who has alleged Walliams "groomed" her as a teenager, has told BBC Newsnight that she was "angry" at his behaviour.

title: Watch: UK falls silent to mark Armistice Day
summary: People from Belfast to Cardiff, London to Edinburgh held the two-minute silence to mark the end of World War One and to remember those who have died in conflicts.
